in_sanskrit.name: मोहिन्दर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Moha means 'delusion' or 'mind' and hinda means 'mind' or 'delight'. So, Mohinder means 'Delighting the mind'.

in_hindi.name: मोहिन्दर
in_hindi.long_meaning: Mohinder is a Hindi name that means 'Delusion of a Hindu'. The name is derived from the words 'moha' which means 'delusion' and 'hindu' which means 'Hindu'. So, the name Mohinder signifies a Hindu who is deluded.

in_tamil.name: மோகிந்தர்
in_tamil.long_meaning: Mohinder is a Tamil name which means 'Protector of the Mind'. The name is derived from the words 'mogam' which means 'mind' and 'ndhar' which means 'protector'. Thus, Mohinder is a name that signifies a protector of the mind.

in_telugu.name: మోహిందర్
in_telugu.long_meaning: Mohinder is a Telugu name which means 'Lord of the Mind'. The name is derived from the words 'mohadhu' which means 'mind' and 'indru' which means 'Lord Indra'. Thus, Mohinder is a name that signifies the lord of the mind.

in_marathi.name: Mohinder
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mohinder हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mohinder is derived from the Sanskrit words 'mohana' meaning 'to attract' and 'indra' meaning 'moon'. The name signifies one who attracts the moon or one who is of the mind of Indra. In Hindu mythology, Indra is the king of the gods and the deity of rain.

in_bengali.name: Mohinder
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Moon, mind
in_bengali.long_meaning: Mohinder একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Mohinder is derived from the Sanskrit words 'mohana' meaning 'to attract' and 'indra' meaning 'moon'. The name signifies one who attracts the moon or one who is of the mind of Indra. In Hindu mythology, Indra is the king of the gods and the deity of rain.
